title: C3 Curation publication endpoint
description: POST /api/newsroom/curation/publication {operation,payload} -> cyclotron-publication/v1; status/decide delegate to hosted_publications rules; other operations refused with a stable code; contractVersion and scope match the pins.

comments.author: home
comments.text: POST /api/newsroom/curation/publication: status and decide follow hosted_publications rules (status 503 before a snapshot, decide 503 live_disabled, 409 stale binding/pending). review/steer/history/events/replay refused 409 operation_unavailable; unknown op 400. DESCOPED: a valid decide for a bearer caller is refused 409 operation_unavailable because the queue worker needs a stored original session; needs a follow-up ticket if decisions are wanted through the lab for Papyrus tokens. Specs: status_follows_the_existing_hosted_publication_rules, decide_keeps_the_live_disabled_refusal..., operations_other_than_status_and_decide_are_refused_with_a_stable_code.
